name: Nemuranu Machi no Cinderella
original_name: 眠らぬ街のシンデレラ
source:
You are a new editor at a women's magazine covering the opening party of a casino in Roppongi, the nightlife district of Tokyo. You enter the gorgeous luxury hotel and meet a group of dazzling socialities. In the VIP room, you get a new assignment covering a famous actor, bestselling novelist, charismatic plastic 
surgeon, and a top F1 racer…and suddenly find yourself perched on a bed in the hotel suite!? A totally gorgeous—and slightly dangerous—love is waiting!

[from [url=http://voltage.co.jp/images/english/corporate/120918_sleepless.pdf]Voltage's news release[/url]]
translation:
你是一家女性杂志的新编辑，负责报道东京夜生活区六本木一家赌场的开业派对。你走进华丽的豪华酒店，遇见了一群眼花缭乱的社交名流。在贵宾室，你会收到一个新的任务，包括著名演员、畅销小说家、魅力塑料 
外科医生、顶级F1赛车手……突然发现自己坐在酒店套房的床上！？一段华丽而又有点危险的爱情正在等待着！

【摘自[url=http://voltage.co.jp/images/english/corporate/120918_sleepless.pdf]Voltage新闻稿[/url]】
